limits: These suites execute the actual five classic scripts using the shared minimal DOM harness. They do not use a browser layout engine.
Scenario groups and render passes are different measures and must not be added together as independent end-to-end tests.
Payment, login, inventory, refunds, shipping and support remain prototype simulations; no live banking, backend, SMS or logistics service was validated.
No server credentials or personal test fixture values are included in these result files.
